meta.title: D3FEND for Space Overview
meta.description: An overview of the artifacts, relationships, and countermeasures added to the D3FEND ontology for D3FEND for Space. This is not meant to be complete or show all possible relationships and instead highlights some of the core concepts in the initial release of D3FEND for Space.

data.label: Ground Station Modeling
user_properties:
Our model of ground station components is a work in progress and will likely be updated with specific subclasses (e.g., Antenna Controller) in a 
future release.


Typical enterprise IT assets such as servers, workstations, etc. that may be found at a ground station are already modeled in D3FEND.

data.label: GNSS sub-model
user_properties:
This is our first pass at a GNSS model, and we expect to flesh it out with additional classes for things like Ephemeris
and PNT Solutions as well as specific countermeasures in a future release.

data.label: Sensors and Actuators
user_properties:
We expect to refine these classes with
space-specific sub-classes such as Star Trackers
and Magnetorquers as well as non domain-specific
sensors such as Thermometers (thermal transducer
sensors) in a future release.

data.label: EMAG Rad Hardening
user_properties:
This countermeasure can be applied to any device
that is a sub-class of d3f:HardwareDevice.

data.label: Safe Mode
user_properties:
This is currently the only spacecraft-specific
operating mode that we have modeled, but
more may be added in a future release.

data.label: Wireless Link
user_properties:
Instances of d3f:WirelessLink can be used to represent Satellite
Uplinks and Downlinks.

data.label: Watchdog Timers
user_properties:
Our model of watchdog timers also includes hardware
watchdog timers, which may be built into an embedded CPU
contained within a physically separate chip.

data.label: Vehicle Software
user_properties:
This class is meant to encompass any type of software
running on a vehicle. Currently, we have specific 
sub-classes for Vehicle Control Software but more may be
added in a future release.

data.label: Signals
user_properties:
Signals in our model can carry any form of d3f:DigitalInformation,
including things like Telecommands, Software, and Cryptographic Keys.
